primaryTask: Choose and reuse a complete page example across application, account, public website and commerce workflows.

defects.evidence: The catalog has eight examples but Kanban only appears in the component lab
Notifications are available only as a component demo
defects.expectedEffect: Review unread notifications alongside related activity

defects.evidence: The existing workspace shows two collaborators but no directory

defects.problem: Missing composed billing, knowledge and editing pages
defects.evidence: Original eight-page catalog has no billing, help or document editor preview

defects.problem: Missing complete account and recovery examples
defects.evidence: Original catalog has forms but no account journey or recovery page
defects.expectedEffect: Demonstrate profile entry and useful error recovery

defects.evidence: Original catalog has no product, bag or checkout
defects.expectedEffect: Choose a product and see the actual selected variant, quantity and total

defects.problem: Composed examples need truthful source guidance
defects.evidence: A single block install command cannot recreate a complete composed page
defects.expectedEffect: Open composition source and browse the actual installable blocks

defects.problem: More page families must preserve the approved catalog at all sizes
defects.evidence: 30 previews and seven categories increase the catalog density
defects.expectedEffect: Keep search, heading and previews contained and readable

productPrecedent.name: Northstar workspace
productPrecedent.divergences: Application examples reuse the Northstar shell and component vocabulary. Public marketing, account and commerce pages use a wider header and editorial composition suited to browsing and purchasing; shared theme, controls, focus and feedback remain consistent.
